purpose: Post-submit experience for the Employer journey. Replaces a generic thank-you: states what happens next, previews the timeline, offers a CTA and a recommended next action, and hosts the optional 'how did you hear' question.
title: Your hiring enquiry is with our Talent Engineering team.
body: We'll review what you shared and continue the conversation using the contact details provided.

whatHappensNext.label: We review your enquiry
whatHappensNext.detail: Our Talent Engineering team reviews your role, timeline and any brief you shared.

whatHappensNext.label: We reach out to align
whatHappensNext.detail: We contact you on your preferred channel to confirm the requirement.

whatHappensNext.label: Verified talent introduced
whatHappensNext.detail: We introduce candidates with verified work evidence that fit the role.
